protocol.preprocessing: PIL RGB BILINEAR224 ImageNet mean/std; no augmentation
protocol.memory: independent model; restore checkpoint memory before EACH image
protocol.meaning: development engineering loop, not independent confirmation

stop_rules.technical_failures: order dependence,GT training access,identity/budget mismatch,NaN,resume mismatch -> BLOCKED
stop_rules.segmentation_risk: new_dev >=50% images zero area or area>=.99 AND image-macro F1<=.05 -> stop formal request
stop_rules.numeric_saturation: new_dev >=90% images probability mean<=.01 or>=.99 -> stop formal request
stop_rules.no_tuning: no loss/lr/threshold changes based on preflight results
